" ) def render_blog_post(author_id: str, post_heading: str, content: str, labels: list[str]) -> str: """ Generate a safe, XSS‑protected HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author_id : str Identifier of the post's creator. post_heading : str Heading/title of the user's post. content : str Main body/content of the post. labels : list[str] Labels/tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str An HTML string safe for inclusion in a web page. """ # Escape all user‑controlled input to prevent XSS safe_author_id = html.escape(author_id, quote=True) safe_heading = html.escape(post_heading, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content) # Build the tags markup tag_spans = [] for tag in labels: safe_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) tag_spans.append(f"{safe_tag}") labels_html = " ".join(tag_spans) # Format the final HTML return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_id=safe_author_id, post_heading=safe_heading, content=safe_content, labels=labels_html )
